resources.string: What is on, what is cheap, what helps
Hand a sneaker to another runner
Step totals start from zero every Monday. The reward for finishing waits in the Events tab.
Crew runs count for the crew board
Kilometres run from a crew lobby add to that crew\'s total. Rankings → Crews shows where yours stands.
Flash runs start the same way as crew runs
Join from the board, mark yourself ready, and the host starts everyone at once. Party size raises what you earn.
Headlines are gathered once a day from public news feeds. Only the title, source and date are stored here — tap to read the article at its source. Rewards and progress live in the Events tab.
Shoes, supplements and small kit, priced in the SUP you ran for. Below is what the first shelf will carry.
Prices are shown so you can see what SUP will buy. Nothing here charges you yet — checkout opens with the store.
The StepUp store is being built
Shoes, supplements and kit, paid in SUP. Deals will land on this page the day checkout opens.
Once the chain link is live you will be able to hand a sneaker to another runner for SUP. Keep the ones you like.
Make a course by running it
Courses → Create → record a run, and the line you ran becomes a course other runners can follow. Already live.
Leg swings, ankle circles, a slow first kilometre. Moving the joints through their range beats holding a stretch — that comes after, when the muscle is warm.
Most of your running should feel easy
If you can hold a conversation, you are in the range that builds endurance. Runs that hurt every time are how injuries start, not how you get faster.
A week of less is part of the plan
Fitness is built while you rest, not while you run. Every third or fourth week, cut the distance and keep the rhythm.
Landing under your body instead of ahead of it takes load off the knee. Your cadence on the run screen is the number to watch.
Notices are written by StepUp. Dated offers appear here only once they can actually be redeemed.
General running guidance written by StepUp, not medical advice. If something hurts, see a professional.
Tap a bar for that day
Every Step. Every Stride. Every Day.
Allow physical activity access so your steps are tracked and SUP stacks up.
This device (or emulator) has no step sensor. Use the simulate button on the run screen to try the flow.
Sunrise run hits different. Who\'s in for Saturday?
%1$d who are not ready sit this one out.
Run it together as a party · +%1$d%% earnings
Every crewmate adds +10% earnings, up to +50%.
%1$s steps rewarded with a %2$d%% party boost
Join the crew to run together
Each level adds +0.15 earning rate and boosts stats.
Luck on your equipped sneaker raises the odds of a rare drop.
Every pair belongs to one of four factions and a rarity tier. Boosts stay deliberately small — about +1% per tier — so collecting is about the look and the album, not raw power.
Run, earn, and unlock exclusive on-chain rewards.
I\'m earning SUP just by walking on StepUp. Come run with me!
Edit the message before you send it. You pick the app next.
Rewards, crew invites and event updates will show up here.
Daily goal hit! %1$s day streak · +%2$s SUP
Hit your goal for daily bonus SUP — streaks make it bigger.
Tap a bar for that week
Nudge me if I\'m behind in the evening
Let crewmates ping me for a run
Everything — your steps, sessions, SUP ledger and sneakers — stays in local storage on this device. There is no account and no server upload.
Clears your notification history. Steps, SUP and sneakers are kept.
Start a run from the home screen. Steps counted during an active session earn SUP, scaled by your sneaker and any boosts.
Energy ran out. One energy covers 600 steps and it refills to full every midnight.
Rarity sets the stat ceiling and max level. Higher Luck on your equipped pair improves your odds when minting.
On-chain transfer to GIWA Chain is still in development. Your balance is safe until then.
Questions or bug reports are welcome through the project repository.
Linking accounts will let you carry SUP on-chain and sync steps across devices.
One run is all it takes to earn your first SUP.
Soon you\'ll be able to swap SUP into tokens on GIWA Chain.
On-chain settlement opens with the mainnet launch. Your balance carries over 1:1 when it does.
You have enough to withdraw at launch 🎉

You haven\'t joined a crew yet. Join one below or start your own.
Top %3$d by score: %1$d per like, %2$d per comment. Picked fresh every Monday at 9am KST — a post is only ever featured once.
Runners nearby see your flash run first — the closer it is, the higher it shows.
Gather runners near you and run together
You\'ll be the host. Members can post and join party runs right away.
No crew posts yet. Start the conversation.
No connection — couldn\'t load the leaderboard.
Sign in again to see the leaderboard.
No runs yet. One run puts you on the board.
Every kilometre you run counts for the faction of the sneaker you had on. You may not be #1 — your faction still can be.
Only crew runs count here — kilometres a member ran alone don\'t. Otherwise the biggest crew wins by existing.
No crew runs in this window yet. One run together starts the board.
%1$d segment(s) ignored — faster than a person can run.
This could not be verified as a run, so nothing was credited.
We start at 6:30 and wrap up in exactly 40 minutes.
400m × 8. Bonus points if you can hold the pace with me.
Slow and steady. We stop twice for snacks.
Six months ago 3K wrecked me. Today I finished in 1:58. Consistency really is the whole trick.
What do you all do on rainy days?
The treadmill bores me to death. Anyone got an indoor routine that actually sticks?
All from commuting on foot. It adds up faster than I expected.
Energy tip — don\'t burn it all in the morning
Energy refills at midnight, so on evening-run days spend only half of it early. Your total earnings come out higher.
Mint while wearing your highest-luck pair
The luck stat on your equipped sneaker feeds straight into the odds for higher rarities. Swap right before you mint.
Party runs pay off from four people up
The boost scales with headcount, so it clearly beats running alone. Everyone has to hit ready in the lobby before it starts.
Let\'s set this week\'s crew goal
We averaged 32 km last week — how about 35 this time?
Added a detour around section 3 because of the bridge works. Check it before the next meetup.
We leave at 8:00 sharp — catching up later is rough!
Everyone is already in the party.

From your first run to withdrawal — here is the whole path. Then we will show you where each part lives.
Tap START RUN on the home screen
The server checks that you really ran
SUP builds up from the steps that count
Tap the SUP card at the top of home
The first button at the bottom. Today\'s points, your runner and Start Run are all here.
Second button along the bottom. Running events, deal notices and health reads sit inside.
The third button. The feed and your crew are here.
Fourth button along the bottom. Store, NFT Market and Items sit inside — wear, upgrade and mint sneakers here.
Fifth button along the bottom. Challenges, campaigns and mission rewards are here.
The rightmost button. Your records, points, items and settings.
The SUP you earn shows up here. Tap this card to open the wallet — withdrawal lives inside it.
Today\'s steps, energy and your equipped sneaker live on one screen. The fun fact panel turns your distance into famous landmarks.
Tip: tap START RUN to begin earning.
During a run session every step earns SUP while energy lasts. Energy refills at midnight — pace yourself through the day.
Tip: your sneaker\'s boost multiplies earnings.
Four factions — Fire, Water, Lightning, Wind — with 44 album slots. Mint with SUP, upgrade levels, and equip your favorite pair.
Tip: boosts stay small — collect for the look!
Join flash runs sorted by distance, share tips, and post freely. The ranking card shows where you stand this week.
Tip: the + button writes a new post.
Join or create a crew, then open the party lobby. When everyone is ready the host starts the run — each member adds +10% boost.
Tip: stay within 100m of the host or you\'ll drop out!
Weekly step campaigns and invite rewards pay real SUP. Actionable notifications let you claim rewards right from the inbox.
Tip: check the events tab for active campaigns.
Pick an avatar, keep your runner ID, and chase 100 achievements from Bronze to Diamond — a year of steady running clears them all.
Tip: reopen this guide anytime from Profile.
Your steps and daily goal live here. The right panel turns today\'s distance into fun landmark comparisons.
Earning uses energy — it refills at midnight. When it hits zero, steps stop paying until tomorrow.
Tap here to start. Steps during the run earn SUP with your sneaker boost.
Switch between the open board (flash runs, tips) and your crews — small communities you can create yourself.
See where you stand this week. Tap to open the full leaderboard — weekly steps or SUP balance.
Recruit a flash run or share tips. Flash runs are sorted by distance, so nearby runners see yours first.
This pair\'s boost applies to every run. Tap it to see stats, upgrade, or swap pairs.
Spend SUP to mint a random sneaker NFT. Your equipped pair\'s luck raises the odds of higher rarities.
Swipe sideways to browse your vault. Duplicates stack with ×N — tap to pick a specific copy. 44 slots to complete!
Weekly campaigns pay real SUP. Check progress here and claim rewards when you hit the target.
Your runner ID lives here. Tap the pencil to change your avatar — pick an emoji or a photo from your gallery.
From Bronze to Diamond — a year of steady running unlocks them all. That\'s the tour, enjoy StepUp!
